description: This file provides utility functions for creating different configurations of a Runtime Environment object used in testing. It defines functions to create standard, typed, non-exiting, and non-exiting typed runtime environments, which include mocked functions for logging and process management.

methods.name: export function createRuntimeEnv(options?: { throwOnExit?: boolean }): OutputRuntimeEnv { createRuntimeEnv
methods.description: Creates a runtime environment object with mock functions, optionally configured to throw on exit.

methods.name: export function createTypedRuntimeEnv<TRuntime>(options?: { throwOnExit?: boolean }): TRuntime { createTypedRuntimeEnv
methods.description: Creates a typed runtime environment based on the generic type parameter, wrapping the standard environment creation.

methods.name: export function createNonExitingRuntimeEnv(): OutputRuntimeEnv { createNonExitingRuntimeEnv
methods.description: Creates a runtime environment that does not exit when the exit function is called.

methods.name: export function createNonExitingTypedRuntimeEnv<TRuntime>(): TRuntime { createNonExitingTypedRuntimeEnv
methods.description: Creates a non-exiting, typed runtime environment.
